warnings: PNG contains TWO portrait BOQ sheets laid out side by side in one landscape scan, per spec §11. Rotate the PNG 90 degrees counter-clockwise to read. The physical RIGHT half is the LOWER-numbered sheet and is written to _1.json; the physical LEFT half is _2.json.

EVERY PRICE COLUMN IS BLANK ON EVERY ROW OF THE WHOLE BOQ -- ราคาหน่วยละ, จำนวนเงิน (material and labour), and รวมค่าวัสดุและค่าแรงงาน. This is a แบบ ปร.4 QUANTITY schedule issued unpriced by กองมาตรฐานราคากลาง for the estimator to fill in. Nulls are transcribed, never invented.

The title block is identical on every sheet of the set: form แบบ ปร.4, drawing numbers S-62047 / AR-61142 / SN-62034 / EE-62062 / M-62028, สถานที่ก่อสร้าง ทั่วไป, unit บาท, with ประมาณการโดย and ประมาณราคาเมื่อวันที่ left blank.

*** THIS SHEET USES THE A-01 CEILING NUMBERS AS ITEM NUMBERS -- ฝ1, ฝ2, ฝ3, ฝ5 in the ลำดับที่ column. *** That is the direct join between the BOQ and the material list: ฝ1 = standard gypsum, ฝ2 = moisture-resistant gypsum, ฝ3 = fibre-cement board, ฝ5 = plastered soffit. The descriptions match A-01's entries.

*** ฝ4 IS MISSING. *** A-01 lists five ceiling types and ฝ4 is the ventilated fibre-cement board ('มีช่องระบายอากาศ') used at the eaves soffit. It is scheduled on A-01 and shown on A-12's ceiling marks, but it carries NO BOQ line. Either it is absorbed into the ฝ3 quantity or it has been omitted -- the BOQ does not say. Flagged here rather than assumed.
CEILING AREAS: ฝ1 141, ฝ2 14, ฝ3 43, ฝ5 10 ตร.ม. -- total 208 ตร.ม. The 14 ตร.ม. of moisture-resistant board is the two bathrooms, matching WC1 (2.30x3.40 = 7.8) plus WC2 (2.40x2.90 = 7.0).

*** THE INSULATION QUANTITY IS 94 ตร.ม. AGAINST 208 ตร.ม. OF CEILING. *** That fits A-01's rule exactly -- insulate over ceilings generally BUT NOT over bathrooms and not outside the building. It does NOT resolve the 2" (A-01) versus 3" (A-02) thickness conflict; the BOQ gives no thickness at all.
Both gypsum lines carry a continuation row for the galvanised steel framing with no quantity of its own -- kept as separate items per spec §11.
